reviews.text: I like going here because the pharmacist is very professional and kind. He gives people good advice. There is a large selection.
Everyone is very, very nice.

For the first time (and not the last time) I ordered food supplements from them for my dog. The package arrived on time and safely packaged, and we also received a gift in the form of dog ice cream and a food sample, which made opening the package a real treat and my dog ​​was thrilled. Thank you very much
Very well equipped shop. Friendly staff.
I just popped in to shop, but in addition to the necessary veterinary product, I also left the store with useful advice.

I won't go anymore.
Today I wanted to have our dog checked.
I asked the lady working in the store if the doctor was still available. She replied that she wasn't sure, because the doctor had previously indicated that he had to leave earlier.
We set off in the direction of the waiting room, where I assumed the doctor and his assistant were working. (I saw the doctor).
The lady in the store arrived in the waiting room earlier, then came out in low whispers and said that the doctor had already left and would be available again on Monday. She said all this without batting an eye. She looked at me like I was stupid, she pushed the untruth into my face so much that I almost believed it.
I also told her that what she was saying was ridiculous, because I had seen the doctor.
That's it….
The pharmacy is very well equipped and the staff is trained and friendly. You don't need to make an appointment with the vet, but ask if there are any appointments available that day before you go!

We ordered 2 bottles of Reconvales tonicum appetite stimulant, which is said to help cats and dogs' appetite. Well, it's no good at all, neither the dog nor the cat can smell it, they literally turn away from it. They don't consume it in any form!
Great selection, helpful service.
I can find very special things that I need, and the service is extremely kind!

I have been ordering from them for years, for quite a lot of money on a monthly basis.
Yesterday, when I opened the 28,880 HUF package, one of my tinned meat patties was damaged and open. I took a picture, sent it to them by email, and asked them to send me an unopened one by mail.
Their response was to take it back in person and they would replace it.
I order from the web store because I can't afford to go to the pharmacy.
I was immensely disappointed in them, after so many years of monthly orders, that they are not willing to deal with such a loyal customer.
Of course, I will not order from them again, and I have told those who have ordered from here so far not to do so.
It's sad that people leave hundreds of thousands there on an annual basis and they can't send 1 can in return, so it was their mistake.
It's okay, karma is working😅
They answer the phone, are kind and helpful, goods ordered at 2:30 pm arrived the next day, thank you!

Upon inquiry by phone, they immediately reserved the product I was looking for in my name, which I was able to pick up the same day.
Great selection, friendly service.
What is a little negative is that parking in the area is impossible, but that's not their fault. If you can, take public transportation.
Thank you! :)
I always have very positive experiences here, the sellers are very well-intentioned!
The seller was very helpful, he was very knowledgeable about the products and illnesses, I can only recommend him!
Thank you! :)

The selection of goods is good, but if I buy heavy packages, I have to walk a lot to the car. So I don't buy anything because I can never find a single place in the area.
I can't take a sick animal, but I can't load a package into a car, so it doesn't make sense. I think it was a bad choice to move here.
We go to the pharmacy section for dietary supplements and snacks. Everything is at a very good price, there is a wide selection and the staff is very nice!
Kind, helpful service!

The most professional company!!!
They are fast, extremely fair!
The administration is super nice, I can only speak about them in superlatives!
I recommend them with the greatest love and respect!!!!
❤️🫶❤️🫶❤️🫶❤️🫶❤️🫶❤️🫶❤️
There are a wide variety of goods and the salespeople are nice and fast.
Nice service, the people working there are very helpful and nice. It's an experience to go back. The products are at a good price.
The best online pet pharmacy! Fair prices, lightning-fast delivery, wide range of products,
They are polite and helpful!!!

I think I would describe it as extraordinary!
I placed an online order that was significant for me. I sent them a message asking if I had ordered the right things based on my pet's symptoms. The Doctor checked it, the assistant called me to tell me to take my dog ​​to the vet first and order whatever they prescribed. They cancelled my order and refunded the transferred purchase price.
I was very, very moved by this procedure, I have never encountered anything like it before.
You should feel free to contact this pharmacy, I highly recommend it to all pet owners!
Fast professional service, thank you very much, I can only recommend it to everyone

I bought a lot in their old store and they were always helpful…
According to the webshop, Aptus L-lysine is available. However, in the store, the lady at the cashier first claimed that Aptus does not have a lysine product, then after I showed her online that they do and on their website, she said that they have not had it for several years and she had never come across it. She also said that it does not matter which product I bring, it is the same. I said that we have tried all of them, I need Aptus. To this, her answer was, “yeah, they can’t do anything about that”. I indicated that the information was misleading, but the answer I received was to add it to the cart next time and check if it is available to order and they would see what they can do.

I think the webshop should clearly indicate if a product is out of stock or can only be ordered and not have the customer investigate separately. Anyway, it would have been more humane to say that it is written incorrectly, we will fix it.

I have ordered several times through the webshop, and I have only had positive experiences. 👌
They are kind, helpful, and flexible. If something is out of stock, they immediately let me know when it will arrive or offer an alternative. (For example, instead of "I ordered x juti anyway," I ordered the equivalent y juti.)
The packaging is strong, safe, and the product is protected inside.
The sticker on the package is a nice touch, a very good idea.
Thank you for your work, I will order again.😀
Very tidy modern clinic and pet pharmacy. The Doctor is a serious professional, I am always satisfied and so is our little dog. So on

I ordered a jute treat for my dog, like every month, and a toy!
We received the missing logo-footed reindeer from the webshop, which was no longer available, because they found 2 more and thought of us, because my dog ​​loves it, so it was a big surprise for us! Thank you very much, one will definitely be under the Christmas tree, the other one of course he already received 🥰🙌
I really like that it's a real pharmacy, not just an online store, and they've always been kind and provided professional help.
Kind service, huge inventory, well-equipped expert veterinary clinic ❤️

Nice professional advice and service!
Large selection.

Today was our first time at the clinic. We went for a simple rabies vaccination, but we still received a thorough examination: there was also a body temperature measurement and general health assessment questions. The veterinarian and the assistant were very kind and attentive, they informed us about everything in detail. The clinic is clean, tidy, modern and air-conditioned. A special plus is that we found the best prices in the pharmacy in the area, where the girl with pigtails and glasses is also very kind and helpful! I can only recommend it to everyone!
Accurate service, correct prices

Expert help.
We love going here with two Csivi.
Very good prices, cultured service.
She was a very kind and helpful lady, thank you very much🤗😘 …
I really like shopping here, unfortunately our cat got kidney disease, so I do it regularly. They are always nice, we have received a lot of useful advice.

The vet is a real expert. Dr. treated our dog when we were in Pest. I usually call him to ask for his opinion, I give it to him. We have a lot of trouble because of the sebaceous gland, he treated him kindly, he doesn't whine like other doctors. However, down here in the countryside the cost of surgeries is exactly half as much, so I appreciate them.
Regarding the pharmacy part, I think whoever answers the phone should be more clear about what they are selling.
Because we don't sell panties that burn over the phone, but when I went there they had all sizes.
I order online, they always serve me accurately.
Kind, helpful staff. :)
There was a very nice and helpful lady in the store (she had brown hair and blue eyes). I always go there if I can.

Kind, knowledgeable service!
Thank you
I ordered in the webshop a little after 12:00. The next morning the package was in the MPL machine. I received the ordered products extremely quickly, I can only recommend it!
We have the best doctor! I wouldn't trust my dogs to anyone else but István 🥰 …
They buy everything they have and everything they don't have.
Because
Excellent veterinarian

I used to go to their previous store often, both for the doctor and for food.
The selection here is much larger, I admit, but it is simply impossible to park to put in the big bags, canned goods, etc. You have to wait a long time for someone to stop, but many people also park on the sidewalk. This is a big disadvantage, especially if you come with a sick animal, so unfortunately I have to look for another more convenient solution.

The previous store was also more advantageous in this respect, the service with the gentleman there was impeccable, here the little lady with long brown hair is very often phlegmatic and "what is on display" style.
I usually buy pet food through the Vet-Plus webshop. The product portfolio is great, the salespeople are helpful, and I am also satisfied with the customer service!
They are selling frozen meat full of worms and they are even outraged that this has been made public….

I visited the pharmacy today and I am impressed! The best place I have ever been!
The sales lady Izabella shared her experiences with me with perfect expertise, I got answers to many questions, and thanks to her I am trying to switch my dog ​​to raw food. She explained everything about this as well.
I will definitely be a regular customer! Thank you! :)
The ladies in the store are always helpful. We usually go shopping with our dog.
Great pharmacy, good prices, everything is always in order
Transparent website. Precise, bombproof packaging. Fast home delivery. I can only recommend it to everyone.

We chose the Doctor on the recommendation of a friend, and we have been going to him since the very first vaccinations. My puppy is always greeted warmly and with a smile, and during the vaccinations and treatments I receive comprehensive, understandable information about everything. The pharmacy attached to the clinic makes it much easier to purchase the necessary medicines and supplements, where the ladies working there are also extremely kind and helpful 😊
The pharmacy won't serve you unless you pay for veterinary care there.

I would like to praise the brown-haired, bespectacled saleswoman. She is always kind, understanding and has a heart for my pets' problems. She is never in a hurry, you don't feel the pressure here that you do elsewhere. I thank her for this kind care, I will come again because of her :) (ok, the products are good too, but you can get them anywhere).

Nice, cute and helpful sellers
Animal friendly
If you don't get what you ordered, they'll call you and we'll make arrangements

Finally, a store you can visit in person, where you can get the products at a very reasonable price. Of course, you can also order online, but it's close to me so I don't have to pay extra for the courier company.
Always kind, animal-loving care for our pets!
Large selection of bird food at good prices.
very good vet, I recommend it to everyone! 🤗 …
Excellently equipped, reasonable prices, friendly, fully informative service. Helpful staff.
Very big animal pharmacy
Best veterinarian, well-equipped pharmacy!
Kind, helpful staff!😇 …
Friendly staff, fast service
The people working there are very nice, they had everything I was looking for, and the store is also very friendly in terms of prices. 💕 …
